exercises.prompt: Select the 3ms imperfect of وَصَلَ ('he arrives'):
exercises.explanation: Initial و elides in Form I imperfects with kasrah on the middle radical: يَصِلُ.

feedback.rule: Initial wāw drops in Form I imperfects with middle kasrah (يَصِلُ, يَجِدُ, يَقِفُ).

exercises.prompt: What is the 2ms imperative of وَقَفَ ('stand / stop!')?
exercises.explanation: Removing تَـ from تَقِفْ leaves قِفْ, which starts with a vowelled consonant and needs no prosthetic alif.

feedback.rule: Assimilated imperatives drop و and need no prosthetic alif: صِلْ, جِدْ, قِفْ.
